2: A Song, a Psalm, by sons of Korah, to the Overseer, `Concerning the Sickness of Afflictions.' --An instruction, by Heman the Ezrahite. O Jehovah, God of my salvation, Daily I have cried, nightly before Thee,
3: My prayer cometh in before Thee, Incline Thine ear to my loud cry,
4: For my soul hath been full of evils, And my life hath come to Sheol.
5: I have been reckoned with those going down to the pit, I have been as a man without strength.
6: Among the dead--free, As pierced ones lying in the grave, Whom Thou hast not remembered any more, Yea, they by Thy hand have been cut off.
7: Thou hast put me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in depths.
8: Upon me hath Thy fury lain, And with all Thy breakers Thou hast afflicted. Selah.
9: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me, Thou hast made me an abomination to them, Shut up--I go not forth.
10: Mine eye hath grieved because of affliction, I called Thee, O Jehovah, all the day, I have spread out unto Thee my hands.
11: To the dead dost Thou do wonders? Do Rephaim rise? do they thank Thee? Selah.
12: Is Thy kindness recounted in the grave? Thy faithfulness in destruction?
13: Are Thy wonders known in the darkness? And Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
14: And I, unto Thee, O Jehovah, I have cried, And in the morning doth my prayer come before Thee.
15: Why, O Jehovah, castest Thou off my soul? Thou hidest Thy face from me.
16: I am afflicted, and expiring from youth, I have borne Thy terrors--I pine away.
17: Over me hath Thy wrath passed, Thy terrors have cut me off,
18: They have surrounded me as waters all the day, They have gone round against me together,
19: Thou hast put far from me lover and friend, Mine acquaintance is the place of darkness!
